summary: Update the Karma Quest frontend toolchain and stabilize transaction-boundary coverage

spec.reason: The dependency update and test-only transaction-boundary wait do not change journeys, reports, controls, persistence, or release behavior.

design.reason: No visual assets, layout, copy, or interaction design are changed by the toolchain or test update.

validation: Installed the exact lockfile with npm ci, then passed lint, typecheck, all 157 unit tests, and the production build on Windows.
npm audit reported zero known vulnerabilities for the exact lockfile.

The two-tab WebKit regression test now observes the previous raid transaction releasing its shared lock before starting the next four concurrent progress writes; all original totals, best-year, and queueing assertions remain unchanged.
The pull request must also pass its unchanged Chromium and WebKit browser workflows after it is updated onto the final integration base.
limitations: Physical-device and external portal checks are not applicable to this dependency-only change and were not repeated.
